# Reinforcement learning

For new RL, RLVR or GRPO work with supported Olmo MoE models, use
`python -m open_instruct.miles` and follow [the MILES guide](docs/miles/grpo.md),
including its launch checks and configuration conventions. Existing Core/vLLM
(`grpo.py`) and DeepSpeed/vLLM (`grpo_fast.py`) workflows remain current alternatives
for dense-model training; see [their guide](docs/algorithms/grpo.md).
Choose according to model and workload support, preserve the user's selected
workflow, and identify support gaps explicitly. MILES does not deprecate the
existing GRPO trainers.

For MILES GPU runs on `ai2/jupiter` or `ai2/saturn` (CUDA 12.8 host drivers), keep
the pinned MILES image: RunSpec defaults `launch.env.LD_LIBRARY_PATH` to the image's
CUDA compatibility libraries, and an explicit value wins. Revalidate CUDA
initialization and a short training run when the image or driver changes. See
[Jupiter CUDA compatibility](docs/miles/launching.md#jupiter-cuda-compatibility).

# Bash commands
- `uv run pytest`: Run the tests.
- `make style && make quality` run the linter + formatter.
- `uv run mkdocs serve`: View the documentation locally at http://127.0.0.1:8000/
- `uv run mkdocs build`: Build the documentation to the `site/` directory.



## Code Review Rules

Read and follow [CODE_REVIEW.md](CODE_REVIEW.md) when reviewing code.

# Workflow
- Begin every GitHub comment published by an agent with one plain line naming the agent (e.g. Codex, Claude Code): `Drafted by {agent name}.`, with no alert or other formatting. If a person reviewed the response before publication, use `Drafted by {agent name} and reviewed by {reviewer's name}.` instead. Only include the review attribution when that person actually reviewed the response; permission to post alone does not count as review.
- When a PR changes anything under `open_instruct/`, add a summary to `CHANGELOG.md` with a link to the PR (e.g., `- Description of change (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/123).`). This is what CI enforces; PRs touching only `scripts/`, docs, or config are exempt, though an entry is still welcome for anything user-visible.
  - The entry must contain the PR's own URL, which does not exist until the PR is opened. Add the entry, open the PR, then amend the entry with the URL and push again.
  - To skip the check deliberately, put `CHANGELOG=<reason>` in the PR body.
- Always run the linter and make sure the tests pass before finishing a task.
- Prefer running single tests, not the whole suite, when developing.
- Launch Beaker experiment and test scripts with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh [--cuda-version 12|13] SCRIPT` after committing all changes. CUDA 13 images are for compatible clusters such as `ai2/holmes`. MILES uses `--miles CONFIG` and its pinned runtime.
- For the Core/vLLM and DeepSpeed/vLLM GRPO workflows, we have three test scripts (for MILES checks, follow `docs/miles/architecture.md`):
  - `scripts/train/debug/single_gpu_on_beaker.sh`: single GPU, no tools (~8 minutes).
  - `scripts/train/debug/tools/olmo_3_parser_multigpu.sh`: multi GPU, with tools.
  - `scripts/train/debug/large_test_script.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes, no tools (~32 minutes).
- For OLMo-core SFT, we have two test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft_multinode.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- For DPO, we have three test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/local.sh`: local single GPU (no Beaker).
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/single_gpu.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/multi_node.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- Launch the GPU tests with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`.
- CI runs on GitHub-hosted runners without Beaker experiments or image publication. Run GPU tests manually when a change touches GPU code paths. Record `GPU_TESTS=[EXPERIMENT_ID](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)` in the PR body for reviewers; CI does not parse or verify this line, and `GPU_TESTS=bypass` has no effect. The experiment must actually run `scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`; record training/debug smoke runs separately. Existing `open_instruct_auto*` images are no longer refreshed by CI; build from the intended revision with the launcher.
- If you are given a Beaker URL (`beaker.org` or `beaker.allen.ai`), use the Beaker CLI tool to interact with it.
- When a Beaker job stays queued or pending, run `beaker job events <job-id>` before diagnosing why — it prints the scheduler's own reason; don't infer one from cluster documentation. If that reason is the workspace slot limit, it applies to every cluster at once: wait or request fewer GPUs rather than relaunching elsewhere.
- A Beaker experiment can hold several jobs when a preempted one is retried. Read the most recently created attempt for each task and replica rank, not `jobs[0]` or one latest job for the entire experiment, or a successful retry looks like a failure and missing replicas can be overlooked.
- Mason's `--min_runtime <duration>` sets Beaker's `minRuntime` (0, or a duration with a unit of at least 5m, such as `30m`; Ai2 clusters currently allow at most 8h), and `--auto_resume` sets `autoResume`. On allocation-scheduled clusters, a job with a min runtime above 0 is allocated: it queues ahead of backfill and is protected until its min runtime ends, and shorter min runtimes schedule sooner. Its workspace needs an allocation on that cluster, or Beaker rejects it at submission. The legacy `--preemptible` switch, which cannot be combined with `--min_runtime`, maps to `minRuntime: 0` and `autoResume: true`; such unallocated jobs run only as backfill and may wait indefinitely. Passing neither flag maps to an eight-hour protected, non-resumable job, the hardest kind to schedule. Prefer a realistic `--min_runtime` (the time the job needs to reach a checkpoint), and call out this choice before launching instead of silently copying a checked-in script's choice.
- On macOS, GRPO launch scripts that call `mason.py` need `--no_auto_dataset_cache` (before the `--` separator). Local dataset caching runs the training entrypoint with `--cache_dataset_only`, and `grpo.py` / `grpo_fast.py` still import vllm at module level (`grpo_fast.py` from `vllm.distributed.weight_transfer`, `grpo.py` via `vllm_utils`), which is not installed on Darwin. `finetune.py`, `dpo.py`, `dpo_tune_cache.py` and `reward_modeling.py` no longer import vllm on this path since [#1866](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/1866), so their scripts do not need the flag. `mason.py` prints a macOS hint but still attempts caching, so it does not protect you either way.
- The `oe-eval-internal` directory is required in the Docker image for experiments that use `--try_launch_beaker_eval_jobs_on_weka`. If it's missing (e.g. in a fresh clone or worktree), clone it with: `git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/allenai/oe-eval-internal.git oe-eval-internal`.
- When updating PR bodies with experiment results, use the "Runs:" format (numbered list with Beaker links):
  ```
  Runs:

  1. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  2. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  ```

# Naming conventions
- Models OLMo and OLMo 2 (versions <=2) use the "OLMo" capitalization style.
- Olmo 3, Olmo Hybrid, and later models use "Olmo" (standard proper noun capitalization).
- Note: "OLMo-core" refers to the software repository and keeps its original capitalization.

# Coding conventions
- Never use `import logging` or `logging.info()` directly. Always use `logger = logger_utils.setup_logger(__name__)` and `logger.info()`.
- Imports always go at the top of the file, never inline.
- Use `from package import module` instead of `import package.module`.

# Documentation

1. Build docs on your branch: `uv run mkdocs build && cp -r site site-branch`

- Prefer running single tests, not the whole suite, when developing.

Its workspace needs an allocation on that cluster, or Beaker rejects it at submission. The legacy `--preemptible` switch, which cannot be combined with `--min_runtime`, maps to `minRuntime: 0` and `autoResume: true`; such unallocated jobs run only as backfill and may wait indefinitely.   1. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  ```
  2. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  ```

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a listing from the system with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in a message from the system. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

For new RL, RLVR or GRPO work with supported Olmo MoE models, use
`python -m open_instruct.miles` and follow [the MILES guide](docs/miles/grpo.md),
including its launch checks and configuration conventions. Existing Core/vLLM

For MILES GPU runs on `ai2/jupiter` or `ai2/saturn` (CUDA 12.8 host drivers), keep
the pinned MILES image: RunSpec defaults `launch.env.LD_LIBRARY_PATH` to the image's

# Bash commands
- `uv run pytest`: Run the tests.
- `make style && make quality` run the linter + formatter.
- `uv run mkdocs serve`: View the documentation locally at http://127.0.0.1:8000/
- `uv run mkdocs build`: Build the documentation to the `site/` directory.



## Code Review Rules

Read and follow [CODE_REVIEW.md](CODE_REVIEW.md) when reviewing code.

# Workflow
- Begin every GitHub comment published by an agent with one plain line naming the agent (e.g. Codex, Claude Code): `Drafted by {agent name}.`, with no alert or other formatting. If a person reviewed the response before publication, use `Drafted by {agent name} and reviewed by {reviewer's name}.` instead. Only include the review attribution when that person actually reviewed the response; permission to post alone does not count as review.
- When a PR changes anything under `open_instruct/`, add a summary to `CHANGELOG.md` with a link to the PR (e.g., `- Description of change (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/123).`). This is what CI enforces; PRs touching only `scripts/`, docs, or config are exempt, though an entry is still welcome for anything user-visible.
  - The entry must contain the PR's own URL, which does not exist until the PR is opened. Add the entry, open the PR, then amend the entry with the URL and push again.
  - To skip the check deliberately, put `CHANGELOG=<reason>` in the PR body.
- Always run the linter and make sure the tests pass before finishing a task.
- Prefer running single tests, not the whole suite, when developing.
- Launch Beaker experiment and test scripts with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh [--cuda-version 12|13] SCRIPT` after committing all changes. CUDA 13 images are for compatible clusters such as `ai2/holmes`. MILES uses `--miles CONFIG` and its pinned runtime.
- For the Core/vLLM and DeepSpeed/vLLM GRPO workflows, we have three test scripts (for MILES checks, follow `docs/miles/architecture.md`):
  - `scripts/train/debug/single_gpu_on_beaker.sh`: single GPU, no tools (~8 minutes).
  - `scripts/train/debug/tools/olmo_3_parser_multigpu.sh`: multi GPU, with tools.
  - `scripts/train/debug/large_test_script.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes, no tools (~32 minutes).
- For OLMo-core SFT, we have two test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft_multinode.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- For DPO, we have three test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/local.sh`: local single GPU (no Beaker).
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/single_gpu.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/multi_node.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- Launch the GPU tests with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`.
- CI runs on GitHub-hosted runners without Beaker experiments or image publication. Run GPU tests manually when a change touches GPU code paths. Record `GPU_TESTS=[EXPERIMENT_ID](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)` in the PR body for reviewers; CI does not parse or verify this line, and `GPU_TESTS=bypass` has no effect. The experiment must actually run `scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`; record training/debug smoke runs separately. Existing `open_instruct_auto*` images are no longer refreshed by CI; build from the intended revision with the launcher.
- If you are given a Beaker URL (`beaker.org` or `beaker.allen.ai`), use the Beaker CLI tool to interact with it.
- When a Beaker job stays queued or pending, run `beaker job events <job-id>` before diagnosing why — it prints the scheduler's own reason; don't infer one from cluster documentation. If that reason is the workspace slot limit, it applies to every cluster at once: wait or request fewer GPUs rather than relaunching elsewhere.
- A Beaker experiment can hold several jobs when a preempted one is retried. Read the most recently created attempt for each task and replica rank, not `jobs[0]` or one latest job for the entire experiment, or a successful retry looks like a failure and missing replicas can be overlooked.
- Mason's `--min_runtime <duration>` sets Beaker's `minRuntime` (0, or a duration with a unit of at least 5m, such as `30m`; Ai2 clusters currently allow at most 8h), and `--auto_resume` sets `autoResume`. On allocation-scheduled clusters, a job with a min runtime above 0 is allocated: it queues ahead of backfill and is protected until its min runtime ends, and shorter min runtimes schedule sooner. Its workspace needs an allocation on that cluster, or Beaker rejects it at submission. The legacy `--preemptible` switch, which cannot be combined with `--min_runtime`, maps to `minRuntime: 0` and `autoResume: true`; such unallocated jobs run only as backfill and may wait indefinitely. Passing neither flag maps to an eight-hour protected, non-resumable job, the hardest kind to schedule. Prefer a realistic `--min_runtime` (the time the job needs to reach a checkpoint), and call out this choice before launching instead of silently copying a checked-in script's choice.
- On macOS, GRPO launch scripts that call `mason.py` need `--no_auto_dataset_cache` (before the `--` separator). Local dataset caching runs the training entrypoint with `--cache_dataset_only`, and `grpo.py` / `grpo_fast.py` still import vllm at module level (`grpo_fast.py` from `vllm.distributed.weight_transfer`, `grpo.py` via `vllm_utils`), which is not installed on Darwin. `finetune.py`, `dpo.py`, `dpo_tune_cache.py` and `reward_modeling.py` no longer import vllm on this path since [#1866](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/1866), so their scripts do not need the flag. `mason.py` prints a macOS hint but still attempts caching, so it does not protect you either way.
- The `oe-eval-internal` directory is required in the Docker image for experiments that use `--try_launch_beaker_eval_jobs_on_weka`. If it's missing (e.g. in a fresh clone or worktree), clone it with: `git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/allenai/oe-eval-internal.git oe-eval-internal`.
- When updating PR bodies with experiment results, use the "Runs:" format (numbered list with Beaker links):
  ```
  Runs:

  1. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  2. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  ```

- Models OLMo and OLMo 2 (versions <=2) use the "OLMo" capitalization style.
- Olmo 3, Olmo Hybrid, and later models use "Olmo" (standard proper noun capitalization).
- Note: "OLMo-core" refers to the software repository and keeps its original capitalization.

# Coding conventions
- Never use `import logging` or `logging.info()` directly. Always use `logger = logger_utils.setup_logger(__name__)` and `logger.info()`.
- Imports always go at the top of the file, never inline.

88	selectors = [key for key in ("tasks", "sources", "recipe", "rl_manifest", "prompt_data") if key in data]
89	if len(selectors) != 1:
90	    raise InputError(
91	        f"data must select exactly one of tasks, sources, recipe, rl_manifest or prompt_data; found {selectors or 'none'}. ..."

103	**未知字段的「did you mean」提示**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py:99-108](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py#L99-L108)：`fields()` 用 `difflib.get_close_matches` 对每个未知字段找一个最接近的合法名。把 `model.source` 写成 `model.sorce`，报错会附带 `'sorce': did you mean 'source'?`。

121	#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案
122	
123	**练习 1**：为什么 `RunSpec.from_dict` 在返回前就要调用 `compile()`，而不是等用户显式调用？
124	
125	**答案**：加载即校验。`RunSpec` 的职责就是保证「读进来的文件是可编译的」；若允许构造出一个未编译的非法对象，错误会推迟到 `plan`/`train` 才爆出来，排查成本更高。`compile()` 本身也承诺不加载权重和 GPU 库（见其 docstring），所以提前调用没有额外代价。
126	
127	**练习 2**：`[data]` 同时写了 `tasks` 和 `prompt_data` 会发生什么？
128	
129	**答案**：`_data` 中的选择器检查发现 `len(selectors) != 1`，抛出 `data must select exactly one of tasks, sources, recipe, rl_manifest or prompt_data; found ['tasks', 'prompt_data'].`，并提示移除竞争选择器或改用 `data.tasks`。
130	
131	**练习 3**：`--set` 的值为什么字符串要加引号、布尔不用？
132	
133	**答案**：`override_value` 把 `KEY=VALUE` 的右半部分拼成 `value=<raw>` 再用 `tomllib` 解析（[open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py:124-131](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py#L124-L131)）。TOML 语法里字符串必须带引号，而 `true`/`false` 本身就是合法的裸 TOML 布尔值。

136	
137	### 4.2 编译链：RunSpec.compile 与 CoreConfig/RunConfig
138	
139	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
140	
141	`compile()` 是两层配置之间的翻译器：把结构化 run 文件里「研究者语言」的节（`[training]`、`[trainer]`、`[inference]`……）翻译成底层引擎消费的 `core.*` 与 `miles.*` 选项，套上工作流默认值，做跨字段的容量算术（GPU 整除、上下文长度、批大小），最后组装成 `RunConfig(CoreConfig(...), miles_options)` 并整体校验。`CoreConfig` 是 Core 训练引擎的开关集合（frozen dataclass），`RunConfig` 把它与 miles 选项字典合在一起做联合合法性检查，并能编译出真正的命令行参数列表。
142	
143	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
144	
145	```text
146	RunSpec.compile(prepared=None)
147	  ├─ put(target, value, origin)：一切设置的唯一入口
148	  │    ├─ miles 键经 options.resolve_option 归一化（别名→规范名）
149	  │    ├─ 路径键解析为绝对路径
150	  │    ├─ 逐值即时校验（miles 走选项快照 + runtime_values；core 试构造 CoreConfig）
151	  │    └─ origins 记录来源；同目标不同值 → 冲突报错
152	  ├─ RUN_SECTIONS 各键分发：SPECIAL_CONTROLS / FIELD_MAP / core.* / miles.*
153	  ├─ [core] 与 [miles] 显式选项、compiler_cache、records、selection 依次 put
154	  ├─ 拓扑算术：world、rollout GPU 数、TP 整除、colocate 一致性、上下文/响应长度
155	  ├─ defaults 字典批量 setdefault（含 wandb_group 默认）
156	  ├─ 预算判定：num_epoch 与 num_rollout 互斥；否则默认 num_rollout=100
157	  ├─ 异步校正：off_policy_correction 在 score-centering 下映射 score_centering_is（本轮改）
158	  ├─ 保存策略：save_checkpoints=true 时按预算二选一（save_interval 或 save_final_checkpoint）
159	  ├─ 互斥检查：data.sampling.priority 与 prompt replay 互斥（本轮新增）
160	  ├─ 评估收尾：eval 采样默认 temperature 1.0 / top_p 0.95 / 响应上限 32768（本轮改）
161	  └─ RunConfig(CoreConfig(**core), miles, inference_profile=profile) → result.validate()
162	```
163	
164	本轮 diff 在这条链上改了四处：`off_policy_correction` 的 score-centering 分支、异步锚定条件扩展、池优先级与 replay 互斥检查、评估采样默认值。上轮的四处变化（defaults 移除固定 `num_rollout=100`、新增 `wandb_group` 默认、epoch 预算的 `save_final_checkpoint`、launch_warnings 容忍 `num_rollout` 缺席）继续保留。
165

274	#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案
275	
276	**练习 1**：为什么 epoch 预算不在编译期把 `num_epoch` 换算成 `num_rollout`？
277	
278	**答案**：换算公式是 \[ \text{num\_rollout} = \text{num\_epoch} \times \left\lfloor \frac{\text{dataset\_size}}{\text{rollout\_batch\_size}} \right\rfloor \] 其中 `dataset_size` 要等准备好的数据加载之后才知道。编译承诺不读数据文件，所以只能把 `num_epoch` 原样透传，由原生 MILES 在数据加载后换算；保存节奏也因此退化为 `save_final_checkpoint`（只保最终更新）而不是编造 `save_interval`。
279	
280	**练习 2**：`async.off_policy_correction = "tis"` 在 `loss_type = "score_centering"` 开启时编译出什么？
281	
282	**答案**：编译出 `miles.score_centering_is = "tis"`（原生 score-centering 的 TIS 加权），而**不是**旧版 `miles.use_tis = true`（[run_spec.py:756-762](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L756-L762)）。若你同时显式设了 `score_centering_is="mis"`，两个来源对同一目标写入不同值，会被 origins 冲突检查拒绝——这正是 [open_instruct/test_miles_score_centering.py:80-90](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/test_miles_score_centering.py#L80-L90) 钉住的行为。
283	
284	**练习 3**：`launch_warnings` 里周期性 checkpoint 的判定为什么容忍 `num_rollout` 缺席？
285	
286	**答案**：epoch 预算下 `miles["num_rollout"]` 是 None，旧式 `save_interval < num_rollout` 比较会出错。新代码（[run_spec.py:917-920](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L917-L920)）改为 `periodic = interval is not None and (total is None or interval < total)`，没有总 rollout 数时只要有 `save_interval` 就算周期性保存。

290	### 4.3 校验与约束：validation、constraints 与错误三分类
291	
292	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
293	
294	校验分两层：`validation.py` 提供**无状态的单值检查**（布尔、整数、时长、取值枚举、未知字段），`constraints.py` 定义**共享的约束知识**（错误分类、封闭字段表、原生校验选项清单、弃用选项的迁移指引），而涉及多字段组合的规则留在 `CoreConfig.__post_init__` 与 `RunConfig.validate` 里。本轮新增的 `score_centering.py` 是第三种形态：**专题预检函数**——针对一个功能族（score centering）集中检查十余条规则，在 `RunConfig.resolved_miles()` 里被调用。所有检查都是 CPU-only：目标是让你在预约 GPU 之前就发现配置错误。
295	
296	错误三分类（[docs/miles/configuration-intro.md:40-48](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/docs/miles/configuration-intro.md#L40-L48)）：
297	
298	| 类别 | 含义 | 例子 |
299	| --- | --- | --- |
300	| Invalid configuration | 自相矛盾的设置或用错接口 | priority 字段没配 provider |
301	| Not implemented | 适配器尚未支持的功能 | `lora_rank > 0` |
302	| Not validated | 未经验证的运行时组合 | `offload_train=true` |
303	
304	三类都会在训练前拦下，**不是可以忽略的警告**。
305	
306	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
307	
308	```text
309	一个值的完整旅程（以 core.prompt_provider="priority" 为例）
310	  ├─ TOML [core] 节 → CORE_FIELDS 白名单（dataclasses.fields(CoreConfig) 的名字集）
311	  ├─ CoreConfig(**core) 构造 → __post_init__：
312	  │     choice 校验 provider ∈ {shuffle, remind, mixture, pools, priority}
313	  │     choice 校验 reward_reasoning_mode ∈ {required, none}（本轮新增，且排在最前）
314	  │     priority 三件套的类型检查（文本、非空权重表、正权重）
315	  ├─ RunConfig.validate()：
316	  │     resolved_miles() 归一化 miles 选项
317	  │     score_centering.validate(options, fp32_lm_head=...)（本轮新增挂载点）
318	  │     跨字段约束（provider 与 priority 字段、rollout_global_dataset、selection/replay 互斥…）
319	  └─ CLI 打印 "Invalid configuration: …" 并退出码 2
320	```
321	
322	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
323	
324	**错误工厂**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/constraints.py:16-41](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/constraints.py#L16-L41)：`constraints.error(message, category)` 生成带类别前缀的 `InputError`；`NOT_IMPLEMENTED` 会追加「欢迎带测试的实现贡献」，`NOT_VALIDATED` 会追加「欢迎用聚焦 run 帮助验证」。约束文本放在这里而不是散落在校验器里，是为了让生成式文档（`scripts/miles/generate_docs.py`）不必解析 Python 代码就能引用同一份定义。
325	
326	**原生校验选项清单的扩容**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/constraints.py:233-238](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/constraints.py#L233-L238)：`NATIVE_VALIDATION_OPTIONS` 本轮加入五个 score-centering 选项——`rollout_top_logprobs_num`、`score_centering_is`、`score_centering_tis_clip`、`score_centering_mis_low`、`score_centering_mis_high`。这个清单声明哪些 `[miles]` 键属于「原生运行时会自行校验」的选项，open-instruct 侧的 CPU 预检据此放行并交给原生解析器复核。
327	
328	**CoreConfig.__post_init__：reward_reasoning_mode 排在最前**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py:148-163](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L148-L163)：本轮在 `__post_init__` 的第一行加入 `validation.choice(self.reward_reasoning_mode, "core.reward_reasoning_mode", ("required", "none"))`——写 `reward_reasoning_mode = "reqired"`（拼错）会在构造 `CoreConfig` 的瞬间被拦下，报 `core.reward_reasoning_mode must be one of 'required', 'none'`。`prompt_provider` 的合法取值维持五个（`shuffle/remind/mixture/pools/priority`），priority 三件套逐一检查——`prompt_priority_field` / `prompt_priority_source_field` 必须是非空文本，`prompt_priority_source_weights` 必须是非空的「源名 → 权重」表，每个权重要严格为正，权重总和也要严格为正（拒绝全零表）。
329	
330	**score_centering.validate 的挂载点**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py:360-364](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L360-L364)：`resolved_miles()` 归一化选项后立即调用 `score_centering.validate(options, fp32_lm_head=self.core.fp32_lm_head)`——在 Core 解析服务精度**之前**就把 score-centering 的资格条件查完（具体规则见 4.5.3）。这保证 `validate` / `plan` / `train` 三个入口拿到的是同一份判定。
331	
332	**refresh 约束的放宽**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py:781-786](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L781-L786)：refresh（分离式引擎刷新）此前硬性要求 `miles.use_tis=true`；本轮改为 `use_tis` **或** score-centering 的重要性采样（`score_centering_is` 为 `tis`/`mis`）任一即可：
333	
334	```python
335	if not (options.get("use_tis", False) or score_centering.uses_importance_sampling(options)) or options.get(
336	    "use_rollout_logprobs", False
337	):
338	    raise constraints.error(
339	        "refresh requires miles.use_tis=true or score_centering_is=tis/mis, and miles.use_rollout_logprobs=false"
340	    )
341	```
342	
343	**候选概率收集的跨字段校验**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py:164-173](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py#L164-L173)：`runtime_values` 本轮新增一组检查——只要收集候选概率（`rollout_top_logprobs_num > 0`），就要求 `rollout_top_logprobs_num >= rollout_top_k`（对任意 loss 生效，不限于 score centering）；`rollout_top_k` 必须是 `-1` 或正整数。这条规则防止「过滤采样只看前 k 个候选、记录却不足 k 个」的静默错配。
344	
345	**RunConfig.validate 中的 priority 联合约束**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py:534-551](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L534-L551)：
346	
347	- 反向约束：provider 不是 `priority` 时，任何 priority 字段被设置都报 `Priority settings require core.prompt_provider=priority`（防止字段拼错被静默忽略）；
348	- 正向约束（provider 为 `priority` 时）：
349	  1. `source_field` 与 `source_weights` 必须成对出现（要么都设要么都不设）；
350	  2. `prompt_priority_field` 必须提供；
351	  3. `rollout_global_dataset` 必须为 true（priority 提供者要全局数据集序）；
352	  4. 不能与冻结排除表（`[selection]`）或 prompt replay 组合。
353	
354	**`num_epoch` 的正整数检查**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py:649-651](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L649-L651)：`num_epoch` 与 `num_rollout`、`rollout_batch_size` 等同列「必须为正整数」名单，传 `0`、负数或布尔值都会被拒——注意 Python 里 `True` 是 `int` 子类，所以这里用 `type(options[name]) is not int` 严格排除了布尔。
355	
356	**miles 选项快照校验**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/options.py:95-122](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/options.py#L95-L122)：`resolve_option` 用 options.json（原生解析器的快照）确认选项名存在并归一化别名；未知选项报 `Unknown MILES option: xxx; did you mean yyy?`。这让 `[training]` 节里的拼写错误（如 `num_epochx`）也能在 CPU 上立刻被抓到。
357	
358	**CLI 的 validate 分支**。[open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:96-104](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L96-L104)：结构化文件的 `validate` 实际执行 `config.plan()`——也就是说 validate 检查的范围等于 plan 减去 JSON 输出，连物理 GPU 分配（topology.plan）一起验了；低层 `[core]`/`[miles]` 文件的 validate 则调用原生解析器（`workflow.parse_runtime`）。两种情况都会打印一行确认语，输入和运行时检查留到 `train` 阶段。

389	### 4.4 采样与预算：priority 提供者、over_length 与 epoch 预算
390	
391	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
392	
393	上轮（`896a734 → bae4209`）引入的三组变化，本质都是「把一个以前只能在运行时发现（或被静默忽略）的决定，提前到配置期用约束固定下来」；本轮又给第一组补上了池采样侧的对应物：
394	
395	1. **priority 提示提供者**：数据行带有历史奖励优先级元数据（组 1–4），提供者按组序遍历数据。配置层的工作是用三件套字段 + 联合约束，把「用 priority 就必须说清字段名、必须全局数据集、不能叠排除/回放」说死。本轮新增的 `data.sampling.priority` 把同一套分层引入**池采样**（只排序池内新提示，不切换提供者），并新增与 replay 的互斥。
396	2. **`data.over_length`**：准备阶段遇到超过提示预算的训练行时，`"fail"`（默认）整体失败，`"exclude"` 跳过并记录计数。配置层负责取值枚举校验与字段入表。
397	3. **epoch 预算**：`num_epoch` 成为与 `num_rollouts` 平级的预算选择，编译层负责互斥检查与「没有总 rollout 数时的最终存档默认」。
398	
399	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
400	
401	priority 提供者的组序遍历（运行时语义，配置只是入口）：
402	
403	```text
404	每个 sampler epoch：
405	  组 1（历史奖励有分歧）→ 组 2（未知/无历史）→ 组 3（全零且频繁截断）→ 组 4（其他常数奖励）
406	  ├─ 组内：data.seed 固定确定性洗牌（data.shuffle=false 则保持原序）
407	  ├─ 可选组内混源加权：按 source 权重抽下一个源；耗尽的源被跳过并重新归一化权重
408	  ├─ 空组跳过；请求可以跨组边界
409	  └─ 预算用普通 num_epoch / num_rollouts；priority 不强加一遍历即停
410	```
411	
412	epoch 预算的编译期 → 运行期接力：
413	
414	```text
415	编译期（本讲）                     运行期（原生 MILES）
416	num_epoch=2 ──透传 --num-epoch──►  加载准备数据后换算
417	save_final_checkpoint=True  ──►   最后一次完成的更新落盘
418	（不设 num_rollout，不造 save_interval）
419	```

470	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
471	
472	**练习 1**：priority 组内混源加权中，一个源的行被抽完了会发生什么？
473	
474	**答案**：该源被跳过，剩余源的权重重新归一化（[docs/miles/data-and-evaluation.md:277-278](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/docs/miles/data-and-evaluation.md#L277-L278)）。权重只影响抽取顺序与早期预算曝光，不影响一个完整 sampler epoch 内每行恰好出现一次。
475	
476	**练习 2**：`over_length="exclude"` 会不会让某个 `data.sources` 配置源被「掏空」？
477	
478	**答案**：会失败。每个配置的 `data.sources` 条目（及每个已填充的 pool）至少要保留一行以维持采样分配，否则准备阶段在发布数据前失败（[docs/miles/data-and-evaluation.md:556-560](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/docs/miles/data-and-evaluation.md#L556-L560)）。
479	
480	**练习 3**：池采样优先级（`data.sampling.priority`）与独立 priority provider 的分工是什么？
481	
482	**答案**：两者共享同一套 1–4 历史分层定义（`pool_sampling.priority_value` 与独立 provider 一致），但池采样优先级只在 `uniform`/`exposure` 策略下**排序每个池内的新提示**，不改变提供者本身；`core.prompt_provider="priority"` 则把整个提示提供者切换为按组序遍历。前者与 replay 互斥（[run_spec.py:801-802](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L801-L802)），后者与 selection/replay 互斥（[config.py:549-550](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L549-L550)）。

503	 └─ 是 → resolved_miles() 调 score_centering.validate：

505	       ├─ advantage_estimator 必须 grpo

554	并明确：省略旧版 `use_tis`，编译器自会选 score centering 的加权；显式 `async.off_policy_correction="tis"` 也选择原生 TIS 模式；同步 run 可用无加权（`score_centering_is="none"`）的中心化。
555	
556	**测试钉住的行为**。[open_instruct/test_miles_score_centering.py:27-37](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/test_miles_score_centering.py#L27-L37) 断言 refresh 接受 `use_tis=False` + score-centering TIS；[L40-67](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/test_miles_score_centering.py#L40-L67) 参数化断言八类非法配置各自的报错（`use_tis` 同开、FP32 head 缺失、候选数为 0、clip 为 0、`mis_low > mis_high`、非 grpo 优势、自定义转换器、refresh 无 IS）；[L91](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/test_miles_score_centering.py#L91) 起断言 trainer 与 core 两个入口都要求显式 FP32 head。更底层的约束单测在 [tests/miles/test_score_centering.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/tests/miles/test_score_centering.py)。
557	
558	**维护示例的新声明**。[configs/miles/examples/README.md:25-31](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L25-L31)：示例除 `calculate_per_token_loss=false` 与 `reward_zero_truncated=true` 外，现在还必须保持 presented-response grading（`reward_final_answer_only=true`）；示例统一声明 `reward_reasoning_mode="required"`，非思考策略/模板必须显式用 `"none"`；process 与边界格式奖励需要声明的例外见 grading.md。[README.md:302-316](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L302-L316) 记录评估采样协议：策略评估用 temperature 1.0 / top-p 0.95，后台任务显式请求 32768 响应 token，in-loop 评估默认对齐同一采样并把继承的响应预算截到 32K，显式覆盖仍然胜出；裁判采样与训练 rollout 采样相互独立。
559	
560	**示例目录按模型家族重组**。[configs/miles/examples/](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/configs/miles/examples/) 现在分为 `tiny/`（原有 dev/node/three-node 三份配方移入）与 `small/`（目前只有一份 dev.toml 起始拷贝，头一行注释说明「更大模型的拓扑资格验证尚待完成」，内容与 tiny 版一致再加一行说明）。[configuration-intro.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/docs/miles/configuration-intro.md) 中的示例命令路径同步更新为 `configs/miles/examples/tiny/node.toml`。
561	
562	#### 4.5.4 代码实践
563	
564	**实践 E：score-centering 配置的 plan 与三类非法配置**（纯 CPU）。
565	
566	1. 实践目标：看到 score-centering 编译产物长什么样，并亲手触发三类预检报错。
567	2. 操作步骤：
568	   - 在实践 A 的 `my-run.toml` 上运行：
569	     ```bash
570	     uv run python -m open_instruct.miles plan my-run.toml \
571	       --set trainer.fp32_lm_head=true \
572	       --set 'miles.loss_type="score_centering"' \
573	       --set miles.rollout_top_logprobs_num=20 \
574	       --set 'miles.score_centering_is="tis"' > plan-sc.json
575	     ```
576	   - 在 `plan-sc.json` 的 runtime 选项/argv 中找到 `--loss-type score_centering`、`--score-centering-is tis`、`--rollout-top-logprobs-num 20`，并确认**没有** `--use-tis`；
577	   - 依次制造三类非法配置并记录报错：
578	     1. 去掉 `trainer.fp32_lm_head=true`；
579	     2. 加 `--set miles.use_tis=true`；
580	     3. `--set miles.rollout_top_logprobs_num=2 --set miles.rollout_top_k=8`。
581	3. 需要观察的现象：
582	   - 报错 1 应含 `Score centering requires trainer.fp32_lm_head=true`；
583	   - 报错 2 应含 `Score centering is incompatible with miles.use_tis`；
584	   - 报错 3 应含 `rollout_top_logprobs_num must be >= miles.rollout_top_k`（这条来自 validation.py 的通用候选检查，对任意 loss 生效）。
585	4. 预期结果：与 [score_centering.py:11-44](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/score_centering.py#L11-L44)、[validation.py:164-173](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py#L164-L173) 及 [test_miles_score_centering.py:40-67](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/test_miles_score_centering.py#L40-L67) 的断言一致。
586	5. 无法运行时标「待本地验证」，以测试文件断言作为行为依据。
587	
588	#### 4.5.5 小练习与答案
589	
590	**练习 1**：为什么 `score_centering.validate` 要挂在 `resolved_miles()` 里，而不是 `RunSpec.compile()` 里？
591	
592	**答案**：`resolved_miles()` 是**所有入口**（validate/plan/train，包括低层 `[core]`+`[miles]` 文件直接构造 RunConfig 的路径）共同经过的归一化点（[config.py:360-364](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L360-L364)）。挂在 compile 里只能保护结构化路线；挂在这里连绕过 RunSpec 直接构造 `RunConfig` 的调用也一并查到，且时机在 Core 解析服务精度之前，避免半初始化状态。
593	
594	**练习 2**：`reward_final_answer_only` 的库默认为什么保持 `false`，而维护示例全部显式写 `true`？
595	
596	**答案**：`false` 保留历史消费者分发（完整文本、边界抽取、token 输入、门控与裁判载荷都不变），保证存量 run 与注册表 `grading` 声明在被校验之外**不改变旧打分**（[docs/miles/grading.md:7](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/docs/miles/grading.md#L7)）。示例显式开启则是声明新 run 的推荐判分口径（按交付响应），把「改判分输入」变成一个必须显式做出的决定，而不是静默迁移。
597	
598	**练习 3**：评估采样默认从「贪心 0.0」改成「1.0 / 0.95」后，想恢复贪心评估怎么办？
599	
600	**答案**：默认值只经 `setdefault` 填入（[run_spec.py:868-869](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L868-L869)），显式写优先。在 `[inference]`（或 `--set`）里给出 `eval_temperature = 0.0` 即可覆盖；`eval_top_p`、`eval_max_response_len` 同理。README 同时提醒：任务专属协议（如贪心 RULER、BFFL）应逐任务显式声明，不要全局覆盖整套 suite 的采样。
601	
602	---
603	
604	## 5. 综合实践
605	
606	把本讲所有环节串成一次完整的「配置驱动」流程（全程 CPU，不需要 GPU 与真实数据）：
607	
608	1. **准备**：复制 `configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml` 为 `open-instruct-tutorial/` 之外的临时目录中的 `my-run.toml`（注意其中 [dev.toml:30-32](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml#L30-L32) 已有 `over_length = "exclude"`，[dev.toml:71-77](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml#L71-L77) 已有 `reward_final_answer_only = true` 与 `reward_reasoning_mode = "required"`）；把 `model.source`、`output.root` 换成本地占位路径，`launch.workspace/budget` 换成你有权限的值。
609	2. **validate**：`uv run python -m open_instruct.miles validate my-run.toml`，应打印 `Run schema, topology and MILES/Core options validated; inputs and runtime checked during train`。
610	3. **plan 与评估采样默认**：`uv run python -m open_instruct.miles plan my-run.toml > plan.json`，检查输出中的 runtime argv：找到 `--num-rollout 4` 与 `--save-interval 2`（对应 `num_rollouts=4`、`save_interval=2`）；再找到评估采样默认的证据——`--eval-temperature 1.0`、`--eval-top-p 0.95`（本文件在 `[inference]` 显式写了同值，删掉这两行重跑 plan，默认值应原样出现），以及 `--eval-max-response-len 256`（= `min(max_response_length=256, 32768)`）。同时浏览 `launch_warnings`、`stages` 与 `allocation`。
611	4. **错字段实验**：把 `[trainer] gpus = 1` 改成 `gpu = 1` 运行 validate，记录报错（会走 `Unknown MILES option` 路径并带 did-you-mean 提示）；再把 `model.source` 改成 `model.sorce` 记录另一类报错。
612	5. **三组约束实验**：按 4.4.4 的三个实验各做一次（priority 缺字段、over_length 非法值、num_epoch/num_rollouts 互斥），记录报错原文。
613	6. **score-centering 实验**：按 4.5.4 做一次合法 plan 与三类非法配置，记录编译产物与报错。
614	7. **示例家族对照**：`diff configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml configs/miles/examples/small/dev.toml`，确认 small 版只多一行「起始拷贝、更大模型拓扑资格待完成」的注释；阅读 [configs/miles/examples/README.md:1-31](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L1-L31) 的家族划分表，说明为什么 small 不等于「已验证的大模型配方」。
615	8. **交付物**：一份表格，左列是每次故意制造的错误/默认值观察，右列是报错原文或 plan 中的取值，以及「哪一层拦下的/哪一层填的」（`_data` / `fields()` / `CoreConfig.__post_init__` / `RunConfig.validate` / `score_centering.validate` / `compile` 的互斥、冲突与 setdefault）。
616	
617	## 6. 本讲小结
618	
619	- 配置分两层：结构化 run 文件（`RunSpec`，研究者视角）与底层 `CoreConfig` + `RunConfig`（引擎视角），`RunSpec.compile()` 是两者之间带来源追踪（origins）与冲突检测的翻译器，全程 CPU-only。
620	- 加载即编译：`RunSpec.from_dict` 返回前就跑了一遍 `compile()`，绝大多数配置错误在 `plan`/`validate` 阶段就能暴露；未知字段有 did-you-mean 提示，miles 选项有解析器快照校验。
621	- 错误三分类（Invalid configuration / Not implemented / Not validated）由 `constraints.py` 统一定义，全部在训练前拦截，不是警告；本轮新增的 `score_centering.validate` 挂在 `resolved_miles()`，保护所有入口。
622	- 采样与预算（上轮）：priority 提供者三件套要求 provider=priority、字段必填、`rollout_global_dataset=true`、不与排除表/replay 组合；`data.over_length` 只取 `"fail"`/`"exclude"`；`num_epoch` 与 `num_rollouts` 互斥，epoch 预算默认 `save_final_checkpoint=true`，`wandb_group` 缺省跟随 `wandb_run_name` 或 run 名。本轮补上池采样优先级 `data.sampling.priority` 与 replay 的编译期互斥。
623	- 本轮更新一（判分输入）：`core.reward_final_answer_only`（进入全部维护示例，库默认仍 false）与新增 `core.reward_reasoning_mode`（`required`/`none`，choice 校验排在 `__post_init__` 首行）声明验证器看哪段输出、是否预期思考段。
624	- 本轮更新二（score centering）：`loss_type="score_centering"` 参数族经 `score_centering.py` CPU 预检（FP32 head、GRPO 优势、十个旧开关互斥、TIS/MIS 参数）；`async.off_policy_correction="tis"` 在 centering 下改映射 `score_centering_is="tis"`，异步锚定与 refresh 资格扩展为「TIS 或 score-centering IS」；候选概率收集要求 `rollout_top_logprobs_num >= rollout_top_k`（任意 loss）。
625	- 本轮更新三（评估采样）：编译默认 `eval_temperature=1.0`、`eval_top_p=0.95`、`eval_max_response_len=min(response, 32768)`；维护示例按模型家族重组为 `tiny/` 与 `small/`，示例统一声明判分输入字段。
626	
627	## 7. 下一步学习建议
628	
629	- **u8-l3（工作流与执行）**：看 `compile()` 产出的配置如何被 `workflow.py`/`driver.py` 消费——特别是 driver 返回值携带 `num_rollout` 后完成判定的变化，以及 `save_final_checkpoint` 在最后一次更新时如何落盘。
630	- **u8-l12（统一判分输入）**：本讲的 `reward_final_answer_only` / `reward_reasoning_mode` 只是入口；ResponseParts 切分、GradingPolicy 的 objective×scope×require_response 契约、验证器 `selected_input` 直通与注册表校验都在那一讲展开。
631	- **u8-l14（score centering 专题）**：本讲只覆盖了配置入口与预检；训练目标的数学、TIS/MIS 的取值动机、refresh 集成与测量在那一讲深入，并演示 `test_miles_score_centering.py` 与 `tests/miles/test_score_centering.py` 的覆盖点。
632	- **u8-l5 / u8-l11（rollout 提供者与 priority 采样）**：`data.sampling.priority` 的运行时组序、与 uniform/exposure 策略的组合测量，以及独立 priority provider 的组序遍历实现。
633	- 想系统了解每个选项的默认值与交互，通读 [docs/miles/configuration-intro.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/docs/miles/configuration-intro.md) 与 [docs/miles/core.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/docs/miles/core.md) 的 Score centering 一节，并用 `plan` 对照自己的 run 文件逐项核对。
634

# 配置系统：TOML → RunSpec → RunConfig

> 本讲为 update 增量版本。本轮（`bae4209 → 8cd7c9eb`）给配置系统带来四处变化：新增 `configuration/score_centering.py` CPU 预检与 score-centering 参数族的编译接入；`CoreConfig` 新增 `reward_reasoning_mode` 字段（`reward_final_answer_only` 获得正式语义注释并进入全部维护示例）；评估采样默认对齐（temperature 1.0 / top-p 0.95 / 32768 响应上限）；`data.sampling.priority` 与 prompt replay 的互斥约束。维护示例按模型家族重组为 `tiny/` 与 `small/`。上一轮（`896a734 → bae4209`）引入的 priority 提供者、`data.over_length` 与 epoch 预算内容仍然保留。

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 读懂一份 MILES run 文件（TOML）的结构：`schema_version`、必备 section、`[data]` 选择器互斥规则。
2. 沿着 `RunSpec.load → from_dict → compile → RunConfig.validate` 这条编译链，说清每个环节各做什么、错误在哪一层被拦截。
3. 会用 `python -m open_instruct.miles` 的 `plan` / `validate` 子命令与 `--set` 覆盖，在不动 GPU 的情况下排查配置错误。
4. 掌握上轮引入的三组配置语义：
   - `core.prompt_provider = "priority"` 及其约束（priority 设置要求 provider=priority、必须提供 `prompt_priority_field`、需要 `rollout_global_dataset`）；
   - `data.over_length` 只允许 `"fail"`（默认）或 `"exclude"`；
   - `training.num_epoch` 与 `training.num_rollouts` 互斥，epoch 预算的 run 默认以 `save_final_checkpoint` 在最后一次更新落盘。
5. 掌握本轮新增的编译期字段与默认值：
   - 判分输入声明：`core.reward_final_answer_only`（进入维护示例）与 `core.reward_reasoning_mode`（`required`/`none`）；
   - score-centering 参数族：`loss_type = "score_centering"`、`score_centering_is`（`tis`/`mis`）及 `trainer.fp32_lm_head` 强制要求；
   - 评估采样默认：`eval_temperature = 1.0`、`eval_top_p = 0.95`、`eval_max_response_len` 上限 32768；
   - 池采样优先级 `data.sampling.priority` 与 replay 互斥。

## 2. 前置知识

- **TOML**：一种「节（table）+ 键值」格式的配置文件，`[data]` 定义一个节，`[[data.tasks]]` 定义数组中的一个元素节。Python 3.11+ 内置 `tomllib` 可解析。
- **dataclass**：Python 用类声明字段、由解释器自动生成 `__init__` 等方法的机制。本讲的 `RunSpec` 与 `CoreConfig` 都是 frozen（不可变）dataclass，配置一旦构造完成就不允许再改字段。
- **两层配置**：MILES 把配置分成两层——研究者面对的**结构化 run 文件**（含 `model`/`data`/`launch` 等节，描述「我要什么」），和底层运行时消费的 **Core/Miles 选项**（`[core]` 与 `[miles]`，描述「引擎怎么跑」）。前者由 `RunSpec` 承载，后者由 `CoreConfig` + `RunConfig` 承载，中间靠 `compile()` 翻译。
- **InputError**：所有用户输入错误的统一异常类型（`ValueError` 子类，见 `open_instruct/miles/errors.py`）。CLI 捕获后打印面向字段的错误信息并以退出码 2 结束。
- **score centering（分数中心化）**：一种替代 PPO/GRPO 裁剪加权的训练目标——把每个 token 的优势减去同分布的期望（「中心化」），需要记录每个生成 token 的候选概率。它的两种重要性采样变体缩写为 TIS（truncated IS，带裁剪）与 MIS（multiply-importance IS，带上下界）。本讲只关心它的**配置入口与预检**，训练数学留到 u8-l14。
- **thinking / delivered response**：思考型模型先输出 `<think>…</think>` 推理段，再给出最终答案文本。判分时「给验证器看哪一段」正是本轮 `reward_final_answer_only` 声明的内容（详见 u8-l12）。
- 建议先完成 u8-l1（MILES 总览与架构分层），了解「open-instruct 负责配置/数据/奖励集成，MILES 运行时负责 rollout 编排」的三层所有权划分。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 RunSpec：从 TOML 到结构化运行规格

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`RunSpec` 是研究者面对的那层配置对象：它读入 TOML run 文件，做**节级与字段级**的结构校验（哪些节存在、字段名是否认识、路径是否解析成绝对路径），但**不做**任何需要 GPU 或数据文件的工作。模块 docstring 把职责说得很清楚：校验模型/数据/训练/服务/裁判/启动设置、解析路径与覆盖，并把各节翻译成底层 MILES/Core 选项——它只「描述」准备、GPU 分配与输出位置，不执行这些阶段，因此 CLI 可以在预约算力之前先 plan 审阅一遍。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
TOML 文件
  │ validation.read_document（TOML/JSON 解析）
  ▼
specs.from_dict ──training.algorithm=="opd" 且 trainer.backend=="megatron"──► OPDRunSpec（蒸馏，本讲不展开）
  │ 否则
  ▼
RunSpec.from_dict
  ├─ _apply_overrides        # --set SECTION.KEY=TOML_VALUE 逐个写入
  ├─ 顶层字段白名单 + schema_version==1 + name 字符集检查
  ├─ _table(model/output/...) # 封闭字段表（STRUCTURED_FIELDS），未知字段报错并给近似提示
  ├─ RunSpec._data           # [data]：选择器唯一性、over_length 取值、sampling 语法、seed/shuffle、路径解析
  ├─ RunSpec._launch         # [launch]：默认值合并、Beaker 时长/优先级/挂载/保留环境变量检查
  └─ result.compile()        # 立即编译一次，加载即校验
```

关键点：**加载即编译**。`from_dict` 在构造完成后马上调用 `compile()`（[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:262-264](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L262-L264)），所以 `RunSpec.load()` 返回时，配置已经通过了一轮完整编译校验。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**入口与 schema 检查**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:158-195](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L158-L195)：`load` 解析路径后调 `from_dict`；后者先深拷贝、应用覆盖，再用白名单检查顶层节名，并强制 `schema_version` 必须是整数 1，`name` 只能含字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符。这两条是最先被检查的「文件身份」。

**`--set` 覆盖的解析**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:118-136](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L118-L136)：每个覆盖按 `SECTION.KEY=TOML_VALUE` 拆分；键的分段要求小写开头（`[a-z][a-z0-9_]*`），唯一例外是三段式的 `launch.env.NAME` / `launch.secrets.NAME`——环境变量名天然大写。值本身用 `tomllib` 按 TOML 语法解析（[open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py:124-131](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py#L124-L131)），所以字符串要引号、布尔写裸的 `true/false`。对同一键的重复赋值，后写的覆盖先写的（普通字典赋值语义）。

**`[data]` 节：选择器互斥 + over_length 取值校验**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:313-327](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L313-L327)：

```python
selectors = [key for key in ("tasks", "sources", "recipe", "rl_manifest", "prompt_data") if key in data]
if len(selectors) != 1:
    raise InputError(
        f"data must select exactly one of tasks, sources, recipe, rl_manifest or prompt_data; found {selectors or 'none'}. ..."
    )
validation.choice(data.get("over_length", "fail"), "data.over_length", ("fail", "exclude"))
```

- `[data]` 必须且只能从五种数据选择器中挑一种；
- `over_length` 缺省为 `"fail"`，只接受 `"fail"` 或 `"exclude"`，写错值会得到形如 `data.over_length must be one of 'fail', 'exclude'; got 'exclud'.` 的报错。

`over_length` 与本轮的 `sampling` 之所以能出现在 `[data]`，是因为它们都在封闭字段表里：[open_instruct/miles/configuration/constraints.py:294-312](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/constraints.py#L294-L312) 中 `STRUCTURED_FIELDS["data"]` 包含 `"over_length"` 与 `"sampling"`。字段表是「文档 + 校验 + 覆盖率检查」共用的单一事实源——不在表里的字段会在加载时直接报「Unknown [data] fields」。`data.sampling`（含本轮新增的 `priority` 键）的语法在加载期由 [open_instruct/miles/datasets/run_data.py:221-224](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/datasets/run_data.py#L221-L224) 调 `pool_sampling.validate` 检查（要求配置了池，且 priority 只与 `uniform`/`exposure` 策略组合，见 [open_instruct/miles/rollout/pool_sampling.py:9-36](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/rollout/pool_sampling.py#L9-L36)）。

**`[launch]` 节的默认值合并**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:371-394](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L371-L394)：workspace/budget/cluster/priority/min_runtime/timeout 等有一整套内部默认值，用 `defaults | launch` 合并（TOML 里写了就用你的）；随后校验 Beaker 风格时长（`"45m"`、`"2h30m"`，见 [open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py:64-84](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py#L64-L84)）、保留环境变量冲突（`RAY_ADDRESS`、`CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` 等由启动器拥有）以及 weka 挂载路径不重叠。

**未知字段的「did you mean」提示**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py:99-108](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py#L99-L108)：`fields()` 用 `difflib.get_close_matches` 对每个未知字段找一个最接近的合法名。把 `model.source` 写成 `model.sorce`，报错会附带 `'sorce': did you mean 'source'?`。

**示例文件中的本轮新设置**。[configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml:30-32](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml#L30-L32) 在 `[data]` 中显式设置了 `over_length = "exclude"`；[configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml:71-77](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml#L71-L77) 在 `[core]` 中声明 `reward_final_answer_only = true` 与 `reward_reasoning_mode = "required"`（语义见 4.5）。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践 A：最小 run 文件的加载与两类报错观察**（CPU 即可，无需 GPU 与数据）。

1. 实践目标：亲手触发「文件身份错误」与「未知字段 did-you-mean」两类报错，熟悉错误信息风格。
2. 操作步骤：
   - 复制 `configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml` 为 `my-run.toml`，把 `model.source` 改成本地任意占位路径（如 `/tmp/models/tiny-policy-hf`），`output.root` 改成 `/tmp/runs/dev`；
   - 运行 `uv run python -m open_instruct.miles validate my-run.toml`，确认能通过（结构化 validate 是 CPU-safe 的）；
   - 把 `source` 改成 `sorce` 再运行一次，记录报错；
   - 恢复后再运行 `uv run python -m open_instruct.miles validate my-run.toml --set schema_version=2`，记录报错。
3. 需要观察的现象：第二次输出应包含 `Unknown [model] fields` 与 `did you mean 'source'?`；第三次应报 `schema_version must be 1`。
4. 预期结果：错误信息都以 `my-run.toml: ...` 前缀打印（CLI 的 `parser.error` 包装），退出码为 2。
5. 若无法本地运行（如未装依赖），标「待本地验证」，改为直接阅读 [open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py:99-108](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py#L99-L108) 推断输出。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `RunSpec.from_dict` 在返回前就要调用 `compile()`，而不是等用户显式调用？

**答案**：加载即校验。`RunSpec` 的职责就是保证「读进来的文件是可编译的」；若允许构造出一个未编译的非法对象，错误会推迟到 `plan`/`train` 才爆出来，排查成本更高。`compile()` 本身也承诺不加载权重和 GPU 库（见其 docstring），所以提前调用没有额外代价。

**练习 2**：`[data]` 同时写了 `tasks` 和 `prompt_data` 会发生什么？

**答案**：`_data` 中的选择器检查发现 `len(selectors) != 1`，抛出 `data must select exactly one of tasks, sources, recipe, rl_manifest or prompt_data; found ['tasks', 'prompt_data'].`，并提示移除竞争选择器或改用 `data.tasks`。

**练习 3**：`--set` 的值为什么字符串要加引号、布尔不用？

**答案**：`override_value` 把 `KEY=VALUE` 的右半部分拼成 `value=<raw>` 再用 `tomllib` 解析（[open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py:124-131](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/validation.py#L124-L131)）。TOML 语法里字符串必须带引号，而 `true`/`false` 本身就是合法的裸 TOML 布尔值。

### 4.2 编译链：RunSpec.compile 与 CoreConfig/RunConfig

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`compile()` 是两层配置之间的翻译器：把结构化 run 文件里「研究者语言」的节（`[training]`、`[trainer]`、`[inference]`……）翻译成底层引擎消费的 `core.*` 与 `miles.*` 选项，套上工作流默认值，做跨字段的容量算术（GPU 整除、上下文长度、批大小），最后组装成 `RunConfig(CoreConfig(...), miles_options)` 并整体校验。`CoreConfig` 是 Core 训练引擎的开关集合（frozen dataclass），`RunConfig` 把它与 miles 选项字典合在一起做联合合法性检查，并能编译出真正的命令行参数列表。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
RunSpec.compile(prepared=None)
  ├─ put(target, value, origin)：一切设置的唯一入口
  │    ├─ miles 键经 options.resolve_option 归一化（别名→规范名）
  │    ├─ 路径键解析为绝对路径
  │    ├─ 逐值即时校验（miles 走选项快照 + runtime_values；core 试构造 CoreConfig）
  │    └─ origins 记录来源；同目标不同值 → 冲突报错
  ├─ RUN_SECTIONS 各键分发：SPECIAL_CONTROLS / FIELD_MAP / core.* / miles.*
  ├─ [core] 与 [miles] 显式选项、compiler_cache、records、selection 依次 put
  ├─ 拓扑算术：world、rollout GPU 数、TP 整除、colocate 一致性、上下文/响应长度
  ├─ defaults 字典批量 setdefault（含 wandb_group 默认）
  ├─ 预算判定：num_epoch 与 num_rollout 互斥；否则默认 num_rollout=100
  ├─ 异步校正：off_policy_correction 在 score-centering 下映射 score_centering_is（本轮改）
  ├─ 保存策略：save_checkpoints=true 时按预算二选一（save_interval 或 save_final_checkpoint）
  ├─ 互斥检查：data.sampling.priority 与 prompt replay 互斥（本轮新增）
  ├─ 评估收尾：eval 采样默认 temperature 1.0 / top_p 0.95 / 响应上限 32768（本轮改）
  └─ RunConfig(CoreConfig(**core), miles, inference_profile=profile) → result.validate()
```

本轮 diff 在这条链上改了四处：`off_policy_correction` 的 score-centering 分支、异步锚定条件扩展、池优先级与 replay 互斥检查、评估采样默认值。上轮的四处变化（defaults 移除固定 `num_rollout=100`、新增 `wandb_group` 默认、epoch 预算的 `save_final_checkpoint`、launch_warnings 容忍 `num_rollout` 缺席）继续保留。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**`put()`：带来源追踪的唯一写入口**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:482-511](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L482-L511)：每个设置都要写明 `origin`（如 `training.num_rollouts`）。如果同一个目标被两个来源写了**不同的值**，`origins` 表会给出 `Conflicting settings for core.prompt_provider: core.prompt_provider and data.sources` 这样的精确冲突信息——这正是 priority provider 不能与 `data.sources` 混用的机制基础（`[data.sources]` 会自动 put `core.prompt_provider` 为 `pools`/`mixture`，见 [open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:803-809](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L803-L809)；你再在 `[core]` 里写 `prompt_provider="priority"` 就会撞上冲突检查）。

**名字重映射 FIELD_MAP**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:40-67](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L40-L67)：结构化节里的名字与底层选项名并不总一致，例如 TOML 写 `training.num_rollouts`（复数），编译成 `miles.num_rollout`（单数）；`trainer.gpus` 编译成 `miles.actor_num_gpus_per_node`；`async.max_weight_staleness` 编译成 `core.max_policy_lag`。这张表就是「研究者命名 → 引擎命名」的对照表。

**默认值字典与 wandb_group 默认**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:681-735](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L681-L735)：批量 `setdefault` 填入工作流默认（LR 1e-6、8 prompts × 8 responses、上下文 6144 等）。其中：

```python
"wandb_group": miles.get("wandb_run_name", self.name),
```

即 `wandb_group` 缺省时优先跟随已解析的 `wandb_run_name`，否则用 run 名——多条同名 run 可以自然聚成一组对比实验。

**预算互斥：num_epoch vs num_rollouts**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:736-740](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L736-L740)：

```python
if miles.get("num_epoch") is not None:
    if miles.get("num_rollout") is not None:
        raise InputError("Choose num_epoch or num_rollouts; MILES would otherwise ignore num_epoch")
else:
    miles.setdefault("num_rollout", 100)
```

以前 `num_rollout=100` 是无条件默认，会**静默掩盖** `num_epoch`；现在把「rollout 预算」从 defaults 字典里拿出来，改成：设了 `num_epoch` 就原样透传给原生 MILES，两者都设则直接报错。原生运行时会在加载完数据后把 epoch 换算成 rollout 数（见 4.4.3）。

**异步校正的本轮改写**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:751-767](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L751-L767)：结构化 `[async] off_policy_correction = "tis"` 的翻译现在分成两支：

```python
centering = score_centering.is_enabled(miles)
if "off_policy_correction" in controls and centering:
    put("miles.score_centering_is", "tis", controls["off_policy_correction"][1])   # 原生 score-centering TIS
elif "off_policy_correction" in controls:
    put("miles.use_tis", True, controls["off_policy_correction"][1])               # 旧版 PPO+TIS
miles.setdefault("use_tis", asynchronous and not centering and not miles["use_rollout_logprobs"])
```

启用了 score centering（`loss_type="score_centering"`）时，同一个 `async.off_policy_correction="tis"` 不再打开旧版 `use_tis`，而是选择 score centering 自己的 TIS 加权；`use_tis` 的自动默认也排除了 centering 的情形。紧接着的异步锚定条件同步扩展（[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:768-774](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L768-L774)）：异步训练现在要求 `use_tis`、`score_centering_is=tis/mis`、`use_rollout_logprobs` 三者之一作为「策略锚」。

**池优先级与 replay 互斥（本轮新增）**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:801-802](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L801-L802)：

```python
if self.data.get("sampling", {}).get("priority") and core.get("prompt_replay_enabled", False):
    raise InputError("Pool priority ordering does not support replay")
```

`data.sampling.priority`（池内按优先级排序**新**提示）与 `[core] prompt_replay_enabled`（重放**旧**提示的历史层）语义冲突，编译期直接拒绝。它与独立的 priority provider（4.4）是两套机制，共享同一套 1–4 历史分层定义。

**保存策略的二分**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:788-800](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L788-L800)：

```python
if save_enabled:
    if miles.get("num_rollout") is not None:
        miles.setdefault("save_interval", miles["num_rollout"])   # 在最后一个 collection 保存
    else:
        # Native MILES resolves the epoch budget after loading the dataset.
        # Save the final update without inventing a periodic cadence here.
        core.setdefault("save_final_checkpoint", True)
elif "miles.save_interval" in origins:
    raise InputError("save_checkpoints=false conflicts with an explicit save_interval")
```

固定 rollout 预算时，`save_interval` 默认等于 `num_rollout`（保存最后一个 collection）；epoch 预算在编译期**无法**知道总 rollout 数（要等数据加载），所以改为设置 `core.save_final_checkpoint=True`，由驱动在最后一次更新落盘，而不是编造一个周期性保存节奏。

**评估采样默认对齐（本轮改写）**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:864-871](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L864-L871)：存在 held-out 评估数据时，编译默认从「贪心解码」改为「与训练采样对齐的核采样」：

```python
miles.setdefault("eval_temperature", 1.0)
miles.setdefault("eval_top_p", 0.95)
miles.setdefault("n_samples_per_eval_prompt", 1)
miles.setdefault("eval_max_response_len", min(response, 32768))
```

此前 `eval_temperature` 默认 0.0（贪心）、没有 `eval_top_p` 默认、`eval_max_response_len` 直接等于训练响应长度；现在温度默认 1.0、top-p 0.95，响应预算取训练值与 32768 的较小者。显式写出的值仍然胜过默认（`miles.eval_*` 覆盖）。

**CoreConfig：本轮字段的引入位置**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py:43-51](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L43-L51)（判分输入声明，见 4.5）、[config.py:84-85](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L84-L85)（`save_final_checkpoint`）、[config.py:129-133](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L129-L133)（priority 三件套）。

**RunConfig 与最终产物**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py:355-358](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L355-L358)：`RunConfig = (core, miles, inference_profile)`。`arguments()` 把 core 序列化成 JSON 塞进 `--olmo-core-config`，把 miles 编码成普通命令行旗标——「不 import CUDA/MILES/Core、不下载模型」就能产出 argv，这是 CPU 规划的基石。`plan()`（[run_spec.py:934-957](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L934-L957)）再包上 launch_warnings、评估计划与 GPU 拓扑分配，输出一份完整 JSON 计划。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 epoch 预算不在编译期把 `num_epoch` 换算成 `num_rollout`？

**答案**：换算公式是 \[ \text{num\_rollout} = \text{num\_epoch} \times \left\lfloor \frac{\text{dataset\_size}}{\text{rollout\_batch\_size}} \right\rfloor \] 其中 `dataset_size` 要等准备好的数据加载之后才知道。编译承诺不读数据文件，所以只能把 `num_epoch` 原样透传，由原生 MILES 在数据加载后换算；保存节奏也因此退化为 `save_final_checkpoint`（只保最终更新）而不是编造 `save_interval`。

**练习 2**：`async.off_policy_correction = "tis"` 在 `loss_type = "score_centering"` 开启时编译出什么？

**答案**：编译出 `miles.score_centering_is = "tis"`（原生 score-centering 的 TIS 加权），而**不是**旧版 `miles.use_tis = true`（[run_spec.py:756-762](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L756-L762)）。若你同时显式设了 `score_centering_is="mis"`，两个来源对同一目标写入不同值，会被 origins 冲突检查拒绝——这正是 [open_instruct/test_miles_score_centering.py:80-90](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/test_miles_score_centering.py#L80-L90) 钉住的行为。

**练习 3**：`launch_warnings` 里周期性 checkpoint 的判定为什么容忍 `num_rollout` 缺席？

**答案**：epoch 预算下 `miles["num_rollout"]` 是 None，旧式 `save_interval < num_rollout` 比较会出错。新代码（[run_spec.py:917-920](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L917-L920)）改为 `periodic = interval is not None and (total is None or interval < total)`，没有总 rollout 数时只要有 `save_interval` 就算周期性保存。
